cookies.title: Cookie Policy

blocks.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your computer, mobile phone, tablet, or other device when you visit a website.
They help websites recognize your device, remember certain preferences, maintain website functionality, and collect information about how visitors interact with different pages.
Cookies may be temporary and automatically removed when you close your browser, or they may remain on your device for a specific period until they expire or are manually deleted.
We may also use similar technologies, including tracking pixels, tags, scripts, local storage, and web beacons.
Hermosa Residences Inc. (“HRI,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) may use cookies and similar technologies to:

items: Understand how visitors navigate the website
Measure page visits and website performance
Improve website content, layout, and functionality
Measure the effectiveness of advertisements and marketing campaigns
Understand whether visitors submit inquiry or contact forms
Provide relevant property and residential community information
Prevent the repeated display of the same notices or cookie preferences

blocks.text: Some cookies are necessary for the website to operate, while other cookies may be used only after you provide your consent.
Strictly Necessary Cookies - These cookies are required for the basic operation and security of the website.
They may support functions such as:
Because these cookies are necessary, they cannot normally be disabled through our website’s cookie settings.
Functional Cookies - Functional cookies allow the website to remember your choices and provide improved features.
They may remember information such as:
Disabling these cookies may affect some personalized website features.
Analytics and Performance Cookies - These cookies help us understand how visitors use the HRI website.
They may collect information about:
We use this information to improve website performance, usability, and content.
Advertising and Targeting Cookies - Advertising cookies may help us measure the effectiveness of our promotional campaigns and display more relevant advertisements.
They may be used to:

items: Limit how often an advertisement is displayed
Measure property inquiries and other website actions
Show relevant HRI advertisements on external platforms

blocks.text: These cookies may be placed by HRI or by third-party advertising platforms.
Third-Party Cookies - Some website features may be provided by third-party services, including:
These third parties may place cookies on your device and process information according to their own privacy and cookie policies.
HRI does not directly control the cookies placed by third-party providers.
When you first visit our website, you may be shown a cookie notice or preference tool that allows you to accept, reject, or customize non-essential cookies.
You may choose to:
Strictly necessary cookies may remain active because they are required for the website’s operation and security.
You may also manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:

items: Receive a notification before a cookie is stored
Automatically delete cookies when the browser closes

blocks.text: Disabling cookies may affect certain website features, including contact forms, videos, maps, saved preferences, and other interactive functions.
Cookie settings may need to be updated separately on each browser and device you use.
Depending on the cookies and technologies used, we may collect:
Some of this information may be considered personal information when it can identify or be reasonably associated with a particular individual.
Information collected through cookies will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
Session cookies are generally deleted when you close your browser.
Persistent cookies may remain on your device until they expire, are deleted through your browser settings, or are withdrawn through our cookie preference tool.

We retain information collected through cookies only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, subject to applicable legal, operational, security, and contractual requirements.
HRI may update this Cookie Policy when:

items: Website features are added, removed, or modified
New cookies or tracking technologies are introduced
Applicable legal or regulatory requirements change

blocks.text: Any revised version will be posted on this page with an updated “Last Updated” date.
